# Square raster references

The application and `npm test` do not need Qt. These recorded fixtures are independent Qt 6.12.0 observations from macOS arm64, not outputs generated by the TypeScript implementation. See the [evidence report](../../../docs/evidence/studio-square-tools.json) for source hashes, failed candidates and platform limits.

- `square-qt.json`: 161 actual legacy Canvas gestures, including option, visibility, history and cancellation behavior. `square-qt-oracle.cpp` links the existing paintui/paintcore and Qt Widgets libraries.
- `square-wide-qt.json`: 231 inputs with three alpha variants. `square-wide-qt-oracle.cpp` reads the same JSON case inputs and emits separate zero-length line, point and segment row spans. The stored expectations are their per-row union for a complete press/move gesture. Rows use `[y, left, rightExclusive]`.
- `square-thin-qt.json`: 4543 width1 inputs after the desktop coordinate clamp `[-32768, 65536]`. `square-thin-qt-oracle.cpp` reads those inputs and emits 24×24 character masks; stored row spans are a lossless encoding of the `#` pixels.
- `square-ui-qt.json`: actual Canvas geometry and event coverage for public UI checks. Color expectations in the browser tests use separately specified straight-RGBA equations.

The standalone wide generator needs Qt Gui/Core; the thin generator also creates an isolated QApplication and needs Qt Widgets. Compile with C++20 against the stated Qt version, provide the corresponding JSON file as its single argument, and run widget probes with `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen`. Save new output separately and compare it before replacing a fixture. Do not regenerate expected pixels from the product engine. Original compile commands and raw Qt observations are retained with the evidence.

The C++ copies have formatting changes only; lexical token equivalence was checked. Qt implementation bodies were not copied into these probes. They use public QPainter/Canvas APIs. Geometry equivalence does not imply identical Qt premultiplied color rounding: the application preserves its straight-RGBA storage policy.
